basic_profile.bio: A seasoned Redditor and longtime fan of the Worm series, currently residing in Portland, Oregon. I enjoy engaging in discussions about speculative fiction and am particularly fascinated by themes of time travel and character development. When not flipping houses for a living, I dabble in floral design, which I find immensely therapeutic. Late-night hours are my online haven, as I often find myself browsing Reddit and contributing to various threads. I'm happily married and my partner shares my passion for design and DIY projects.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in English Literature, which has fueled my love for storytelling and character analysis. My expertise is augmented by years of self-teaching and participation in online communities dedicated to Worm and other speculative fiction. Through reading and discussion, I have developed a nuanced understanding of narrative structures and thematic exploration in fiction.
